sentences.text: The respondent no.2 is identified by Mr. Deepak Singh Bisht, Advocate.
4. Both, the applicant, the husband of the respondent no.2, and the respondent no.2 submitted that they have settled their disputes.
They are living together.
They further submitted that they have filed a Compounding Application (IA No.01 of 2025) and affidavits with their free will and without any pressure.
The respondent no.2 has requested to quash the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.916 of 2024.

5. The said request has not been opposed by the respondent no.1.
6.

Considering the totality of the matter, this Court is of the view that ends of justice would be met if the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.916 of 2024, "State vs. Rashid", pending before the court of Judicial Magistrate, Jaspur, District Udham Singh Nagar, are quashed.
